widgets.name: SeedancePromptV9Widget
widgets.description: V8 board that sends to both Seedance 2.0 (9 images / 3 videos / 3 audio, fixed video slots) and Seedance 2.5 (30 / 10 / 10 reference lists). The meter follows the selected target.

widgets.name: ImageGenPromptWidget
widgets.description: V5-style prompt editor for image generation: @ mention workflow images, drag to reorder, and a Send to Image Gen button that pushes prompt + references into Nano Banana / GPT Image / Seedream nodes.

metadata.description: V8 that also drives Seedance 2.0: 2.5 nodes still get 30 images / 10 videos / 10 audio lists; 2.0 nodes are switched to Multimodal References and filled at 9 / 3 / 3, with videos written to reference_video_1..3.

Seedance V5 process for image generation: scans the workflow for imported images, @ mention them in the prompt, then Send to Image Gen writes the prompt + ordered reference images directly into every (or one selected) Nano Banana / GPT Image / Seedream node.
